title: 6 Truck Problems Nobody Warns You About (Check Before You Buy in 2027)
description:
Six truck problems that keep showing up in recalls, studies, lawsuits and owner reports, and that most buyers never hear about, with a 7-point test drive for 2027. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:14 1. Screens and phone connection
4:40 2. Backup cameras
7:24 3. Trailer electronics
9:44 4. 10-speed transmissions
12:26 5. Rear axles and rollaway
15:33 6. Death wobble
17:57 Bonus: 3.0L Duramax and Ram ESC software
19:55 The 7-point test drive for 2027

Sources:
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, J.D. Power 2026 VDS findings: https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2026/02/most-reliable-2026-truck-is-ram-1500-chevy-silverado-next-toyota-misses-out-jd-power-study/
